LAHORE UNIVERSITY OF MANAGEMENT SCIENCES ORDER, 1985
LAHORE UNIVERSITY
OF MANAGEMENT SCIENCES ORDER, 1985
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 25
OF 1985
An Order to
provide for the establishment of a Lahore University of Management Sciences
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 31st March, 1985]
No. F. 17 (3)/85-Pub.-The
following Order made by the President on 8th March, 1985, is hereby published
for general information :-
Whereas it is expedient to
provide for the establishment of a Lahore University of Management Sciences and
for matters ancilliary thereto ;
Now, therefore, in pursuance of
the Proclamation of fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers
enabling him in that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following
Order :-
1. Short title and
commencement.-(1) This Order maybe called the Lahore University of
Management Sciences Order, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Definitions.--In this
Order, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context,-
(a) "Board" means the
Board of Trustees of the University;
(b) "Chancellor" means
the Chancellor of the University ;
(c) "Dean" means the
Dean of a school, college, or institute of the University ;
(d) "Pro-Chancellor"
means the Pro-Chancellor of the University;
(e) "Rector" means the
Rector of the University;
(f) "University" means
the Lahore University of Management Sciences established under this Order ; and
(g) "Vice-Chancellor"
means the Vice-Chancellor of the University.
3. Establishment and
Incorporation of the University.--(1) There shall be established at Lahore
a University to be called the Lahore University of Management Sciences
consisting of :-
(a) the Chancellor, the
Pro-Chancellor, the Rector, the Vice-Chancellor, the Deans and other members of
the Board ;
(b) the members of such councils,
committees and other bodies as the Board may establish ;
(c) the teachers and students of
the University and its constituent units ; and
(d) such other officers and
members of the staff' as spay, from time to time; be specified by the Board.
(2) The University shall be a
body corporate by the name of the Lahore University of Management Sciences
having perpetual succession and a common seal, with power, among others, to
acquire, hold and dispose of any property or investments and shall by the said
name sue and be sued. ,
4. Powers and functions of the
University.--The University shall have powers :-
(a) to provide for instruction
and training in management sciences and in such allied branches of learning as
it may deem fit, and to make provision for research, demonstrations and other
services, and for the advancement and dissemination of knowledge in such manner
as it may determine;
(b) to admit and examine students
;
(c) to hold examinations and
confer or award degrees, diplomas, .certificates and other academic
distinctions on and to persons who have passed its examinations under
prescribed conditions ;
(d) to select and promote
faculties ;
(e) to confer honorary degrees ;
(f) to prescribe courses of
studies in management sciences and such other branches of learning as the
University may determine ;
(g) to pursue research ;
(h) to establish and support
other facilities for education, training and research
(i) to affiliate or associate
itself with other institutions and to establish faculties in Pakistan or abroad
for the effective discharge of its functions and responsibilities ;
(j) to decide teaching methods
and strategies in order to ensure the most effective educational and training
programmes ;
(k) to use its financial and
other resources to the fullest extent for the execution of its programmes ;
(l) to enter into agreements,
contracts and arrangements with organisations, institutions, bodies and
individuals for carrying out its functions and activities.
(m) to do all such other acts and
things as may be required to further its objectives.
